name: com.admeldo/verified-work
title: Verified Work
description: Verify delivered agent work and get a signed pass/fail receipt, paid per check over x402.

tools.name: verify_work
tools.description: Checks delivered work against agreed terms and returns an Ed25519-signed pass/fail outcome receipt with per-check evidence (ERC-8004 compatible). job_type 'dataset_spec/v1': artifact is an array of rows; spec may set row_schema (JSON Schema), min_rows, max_rows, unique_key, freshness {field, max_age_seconds}. job_type 'json_response/v1': artifact is a JSON body; spec may set json_schema, required_fields (JSON Pointers), value_constraints, http_status, max_size. Costs the same x402 price as POST /verify (currently $0.02 USDC on Base). Pay with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header on this tools/call; this server never accepts a wallet private key. Malformed input is rejected with no charge.

spec.description: Acceptance criteria for the job type

artifact.description: dataset_spec/v1: array of row objects. json_response/v1: the delivered JSON body.

status.description: json_response/v1 only: HTTP status the delivered response had

subject.description: Optional ids of the worker/buyer agents (e.g. ERC-8004 agentId)

tools.name: check_receipt
tools.description: Fetches a Verified Work receipt by id (or takes the receipt JSON) and verifies its Ed25519 signature against the verifier's published key. Free.

tools.name: get_price
tools.description: Returns the verifier's current x402 payment terms (amount, asset, network, recipient) without paying. Free.
